ImageDescription.value:
Fonthill, Ontario. Sometimes it is the constraints that we face that motivate us. Sometimes when we are told that something is not possible, we are driven to achieve it, to prove that it is possible, to prove the naysayers wrong.

Also, sometimes it is the constraints that drive innovation. It is the limitations of some tool or some process that drive us to find a better way to do something.

Sometimes, it is the shortcomings of a job or place of employment that drive us to find the career that we really have a passion for.

Sometimes, the fence is what defines that which is enclosed.

Don't fence me in"
